    /* =====================================================
       HERO SECTION
    ===================================================== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: var(--sp-24) 0 var(--sp-20);
      background: var(--bg-page);
    }

    /* Background blobs */
    .hero::before,
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    .hero::before {
      width: 600px;
      height: 600px;
      top: -200px;
      right: -150px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.18) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .hero::after {
      width: 500px;
      height: 500px;
      bottom: -150px;
      left: -100px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(67% 0.21 46 / 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .hero-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-16);
      align-items: center;
    }

    .hero-content { max-width: 560px; }

    .hero-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      padding: var(--sp-1) var(--sp-4);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: var(--brand-purple);
      background: oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.08);
      border: 1px solid oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.2);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.75rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.08;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-8);
      max-width: 460px;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .hero-cta-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      padding: var(--sp-4) var(--sp-8);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-purple) 0%, var(--grad-magenta) 60%, var(--brand-orange) 100%);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.35);
      transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease-out), box-shadow 0.2s;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.45);
    }

    .btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

    .hero-learn-more {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-1);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }

    .hero-learn-more:hover { color: var(--brand-purple); }

    /* Hero visual */
    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .hero-phone-mockup {
      width: 280px;
      aspect-ratio: 9/19;
      background: var(--brand-black);
      border-radius: 40px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), 0 0 0 8px oklch(10% 0.01 270 / 0.06);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transform: perspective(800px) rotateY(-8deg) rotateX(2deg);
    }

    .phone-screen {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 8px;
      border-radius: 32px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, oklch(50% 0.28 295) 0%, oklch(55% 0.27 330) 40%, oklch(67% 0.21 46) 100%);
    }

    .phone-notch {
      position: absolute;
      top: 14px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 80px;
      height: 10px;
      background: var(--brand-black);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .phone-content {
      padding: 50px var(--sp-4) var(--sp-4);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--sp-3);
      height: 100%;
    }

    .phone-story-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
    }

    .phone-story-avatar {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .phone-story-avatar:nth-child(1) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b6b, #ffd93d); }
    .phone-story-avatar:nth-child(2) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6bcb77, #4d96ff); }
    .phone-story-avatar:nth-child(3) { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff6b9d, #c77dff); }

    .phone-post {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border-radius: 16px;
      overflow: hidden;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .phone-post-img {
      height: 100px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.25) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 100%);
    }

    .phone-post-bar {
      padding: var(--sp-2) var(--sp-3);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
    }

    .phone-post-dot {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }

    .phone-post-lines {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 3px;
    }

    .phone-post-line {
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .phone-post-line:last-child { width: 60%; }

    /* Floating badges */
    .hero-badge {
      position: absolute;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-4);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .hero-badge-1 {
      top: 10%;
      left: -10%;
      color: var(--brand-purple);
    }

    .hero-badge-2 {
      bottom: 18%;
      right: -8%;
      color: var(--brand-orange);
    }

    .badge-icon {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 14px;
    }

    .badge-icon-purple { background: oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.12); }
    .badge-icon-orange { background: oklch(67% 0.21 46 / 0.12); }

    /* =====================================================
       FEATURES SECTION
    ===================================================== */
    .features {
      padding: var(--sp-24) 0;
      background: var(--bg-card);
    }

    .section-label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      color: var(--brand-purple);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
    }

    .section-heading {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      line-height: 1.15;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-5);
      max-width: 700px;
    }

    .section-body {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 640px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .link-arrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--brand-purple);
      transition: gap 0.2s;
    }

    .link-arrow:hover { gap: var(--sp-3); }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: var(--sp-4);
      margin-top: var(--sp-10);
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--bg-page);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: var(--sp-6);
      transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease-out), box-shadow 0.25s;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 22px;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .feature-icon-purple { background: oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.1); }
    .feature-icon-orange { background: oklch(67% 0.21 46 / 0.1); }
    .feature-icon-magenta { background: oklch(55% 0.27 330 / 0.1); }
    .feature-icon-teal { background: oklch(60% 0.15 200 / 0.1); }

    .feature-name {
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
    }

    .feature-desc {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* =====================================================
       SAFETY SECTION
    ===================================================== */
    .safety {
      padding: var(--sp-24) 0;
      background: var(--safety-bg);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .safety::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      width: 400px;
      height: 400px;
      top: -120px;
      right: -80px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .safety-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-16);
      align-items: center;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .safety-visual {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .safety-card {
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: var(--sp-5);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease-out), box-shadow 0.25s;
    }

    .safety-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .safety-card:first-child {
      grid-column: span 2;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .safety-card-icon {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background: oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.1);
    }

    .safety-card-label {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .safety-card-sub {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    /* =====================================================
       CREATORS SECTION
    ===================================================== */
    .creators {
      padding: var(--sp-24) 0;
      background: var(--brand-black);
      color: #fff;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .creators::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 80% 50%, oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.3) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 60% at 20% 80%, oklch(67% 0.21 46 / 0.2) 0%, transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .creators-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-16);
      align-items: center;
    }

    .creators .section-label { color: var(--brand-orange); }

    .creators .section-heading { color: #fff; }

    .creators .section-body { color: oklch(80% 0.02 265); }

    .creators .link-arrow {
      color: var(--brand-orange);
    }

    .creators-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .stat-card {
      background: oklch(20% 0.01 270 / 0.6);
      border: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.08);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: var(--sp-6);
    }

    .stat-number {
      font-size: 2.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
    }

    .stat-number.gradient-text {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-purple), var(--brand-orange));
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: oklch(70% 0.02 265);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* =====================================================
       TAGLINE BANNER
    ===================================================== */
    .tagline-banner {
      padding: var(--sp-16) 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-purple) 0%, var(--grad-magenta) 50%, var(--brand-orange) 100%);
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tagline-banner::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.05'%3E%3Ccircle cx='30' cy='30' r='2'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
    }

    .tagline-text {
      position: relative;
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: #fff;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    /* =====================================================
       NEWS SECTION
    ===================================================== */
    .news {
      padding: var(--sp-24) 0;
      background: var(--bg-page);
    }

    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-10);
      gap: var(--sp-4);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .view-more-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-5);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--brand-purple);
      border: 1.5px solid oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.3);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.05);
      transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .view-more-link:hover {
      background: oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.1);
      border-color: var(--brand-purple);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* Carousel wrapper */
    .carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
    }

    .news-carousel {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--sp-5);
      overflow-x: auto;
      scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      padding-bottom: var(--sp-4);
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: var(--neutral-300) transparent;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    .news-carousel:active { cursor: grabbing; }

    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar {
      height: 4px;
    }

    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
    .news-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: var(--neutral-300);
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 300px;
      scroll-snap-align: start;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease-out), box-shadow 0.25s;
    }

    .news-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .news-thumbnail {
      width: 100%;
      height: 180px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-thumb-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .news-thumb-bg-1 {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(50% 0.28 295) 0%, oklch(55% 0.27 330) 100%);
    }

    .news-thumb-bg-2 {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(67% 0.21 46) 0%, oklch(60% 0.25 20) 100%);
    }

    .news-thumb-bg-3 {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(55% 0.15 200) 0%, oklch(50% 0.28 295) 100%);
    }

    .news-thumb-bg-4 {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, oklch(40% 0.1 265) 0%, oklch(60% 0.15 220) 100%);
    }

    .news-thumb-icon {
      font-size: 48px;
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: var(--sp-5);
    }

    .news-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
    }

    .news-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.06em;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }

    .tag-announcements {
      color: var(--brand-purple);
      background: oklch(50% 0.28 295 / 0.1);
    }

    .tag-tips {
      color: var(--brand-orange);
      background: oklch(67% 0.21 46 / 0.1);
    }

    .tag-product {
      color: oklch(50% 0.2 200);
      background: oklch(50% 0.2 200 / 0.1);
    }

    .tag-safety {
      color: oklch(40% 0.18 160);
      background: oklch(40% 0.18 160 / 0.1);
    }

    .news-title {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.45;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-3);
      display: -webkit-box;
      -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
      -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-date {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Carousel arrows (desktop) */
    .carousel-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 18px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      z-index: 2;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s var(--ease-out), box-shadow 0.2s;
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      background: var(--neutral-100);
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1.06);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .carousel-btn-prev { left: -22px; }
    .carousel-btn-next { right: -22px; }

    /* =====================================================
       CTA DOWNLOAD SECTION
    ===================================================== */
    .cta-download {
      padding: var(--sp-24) 0;
      background: var(--bg-card);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cta-download-inner {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin-inline: auto;
    }

    .cta-headline {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .cta-subheadline {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-8);
    }

    .cta-buttons {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--sp-4);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn-store {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-3);
      padding: var(--sp-3) var(--sp-6);
      background: var(--brand-black);
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease-out), box-shadow 0.2s;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .btn-store:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-store-icon {
      font-size: 22px;
    }

    .btn-store-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.2; text-align: left; }
    .btn-store-pre { font-size: 0.7rem; opacity: 0.75; font-weight: 400; }
    .btn-store-name { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; }

    /* =====================================================
       FOOTER
    ===================================================== */
    .site-footer {
      background: var(--neutral-900);
      color: var(--neutral-300);
      padding-top: var(--sp-16);
    }

    .footer-top {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: var(--sp-8);
      padding-bottom: var(--sp-12);
      border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.08);
    }

    .footer-brand { padding-right: var(--sp-4); }

    .footer-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--sp-2);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      color: #fff;
      margin-bottom: var(--sp-4);
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--neutral-400);
      line-height: 1.65;
      max-width: 220px;
    }

  <script>
    /* ─── Hamburger / Mobile Nav ─── */
    const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
    const mobileNav    = document.getElementById('mobileNav');

    hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = hamburgerBtn.classList.toggle('is-open');
      mobileNav.classList.toggle('is-open', isOpen);
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpen));
      // Prevent body scroll when nav open
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    // Close mobile nav when a link is tapped
    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a, button').forEach(el => {
      el.addEventListener('click', () => {
        hamburgerBtn.classList.remove('is-open');
        mobileNav.classList.remove('is-open');
        hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      });
    });

    /* ─── News Carousel ─── */
    const carousel    = document.getElementById('newsCarousel');
    const prevBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    const nextBtn     = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    const CARD_GAP    = 20; // matches --sp-5

    function getScrollAmount() {
      const card = carousel.querySelector('.news-card');
      return card ? card.offsetWidth + CARD_GAP : 320;
    }

    prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      carousel.scrollBy({ left: -getScrollAmount(), behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      carousel.scrollBy({ left: getScrollAmount(), behavior: 'smooth' });
    });

    // Update arrow visibility
    function updateArrows() {
      const maxScroll = carousel.scrollWidth - carousel.clientWidth;
      prevBtn.style.opacity = carousel.scrollLeft <= 4 ? '0.3' : '1';
      prevBtn.style.pointerEvents = carousel.scrollLeft <= 4 ? 'none' : 'auto';
      nextBtn.style.opacity = carousel.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 4 ? '0.3' : '1';
      nextBtn.style.pointerEvents = carousel.scrollLeft >= maxScroll - 4 ? 'none' : 'auto';
    }

    carousel.addEventListener('scroll', updateArrows, { passive: true });
    updateArrows();

    /* ─── Carousel drag-to-scroll (desktop) ─── */
    let isDragging = false;
    let startX = 0;
    let startScrollLeft = 0;

    carousel.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      isDragging = true;
      startX = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
      startScrollLeft = carousel.scrollLeft;
      carousel.style.userSelect = 'none';
    });

    carousel.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!isDragging) return;
      const x = e.pageX - carousel.offsetLeft;
      const delta = x - startX;
      carousel.scrollLeft = startScrollLeft - delta;
    });

    ['mouseup', 'mouseleave'].forEach(evt => {
      carousel.addEventListener(evt, () => {
        isDragging = false;
        carousel.style.userSelect = '';
      });
    });
  </script>
